summary: Verified the redesigned SENDbakēd Driver login (bottom-sheet over biker BG) end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases green covering email-register (200 + 409 + 422 + 422), email-login (200 + 401×2), google/verify (401 for bogus code), OTP request+verify regression, /driver/me with the email-issued JWT (role=driver), and DB schema check for migration 0030 (drivers has password_hash + google_sub, phone_e164 is nullable). Frontend on 414×900: card + tab strip render, Mobile tab OTP flow works (country pill toggles +91↔+225, Send Code shows Dev OTP toast and routes to /driver/otp), Email tab auto-registers a fresh account and lands on /driver/kyc/personal, re-login with same creds also lands on /driver/kyc/personal, password visibility toggles, Apple button shows coming-soon toast, Sign Up keeps user on /driver/login (Mobile tab focus), Google button click does not crash. No horizontal overflow at 360/390/414/430. Only console noise is an expected 401 from google/verify and Chrome's harmless COOP warnings — no real errors.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py is now 1259 lines — consider splitting into auth.py / kyc.py / dashboard.py / admin.py modules (>700 line guideline).

google_verify raises 500 when GOOGLE_CLIENT_* env vars are missing; a 501 or a structured 400 with detail.code='google_not_configured' would be friendlier so the client can render the 'not configured' toast reliably.
EmailLoginIn.email lacks the same regex validation as EmailRegisterIn — a malformed email hits DB lookup and returns 401 rather than 422 (minor inconsistency).
test_credentials: OTP driver +919990001234 (IN). Ephemeral email drivers created per-run: qa.email.driver+<ts>@baked.dev / driverPass123!
seed_data_creation: Test creates fresh driver rows per run via email-register — no cleanup performed; rows are inert (status=onboarding). Safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_driver_auth_email_google.py is stable when run without xdist parallelism (loadscope splits register/login across workers and the module-scoped fresh_email fixture is per-worker). Run with `pytest -o addopts=''` if needed. Google/verify test tolerates 500 (skipped) if backend GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID isn't configured.
